records.text: Deviate Coilers are snake-like creatures found in the Barrens.
Deviate Stinglashes are creatures found in the Barrens. They use Lash in combat.
Deviate Creepers are creatures found in the Barrens that use Stealth and Infected Wound in combat.
Deviate Slayers are creatures found in the Barrens. They use Fatal Bite when badly wounded.
A beast called a Deviate Stalker, one of the Barrens' deviate creatures.
A deviate beast that can be summoned into combat and is named among the creatures Ebru asks adventurers to eradicate in the Wailing Caverns.
A deviate guardian whose distress call is a shriek for help, triggered when it is badly wounded.
Devouring Ectoplasm is an ectoplasmic creature found in the Barrens. When badly hurt, it can cast Clone, an unnerving last-ditch trick.
A beast known as a Deviate Lurker, found in the Barrens.
An elite creature known as Trigore the Lasher, a formidable presence in the Barrens.
Kresh is a named creature whose hide is sought by Nalpak for leatherworking.

Mad Magglish is a thief identified by Crane Operator Bigglefuzz: after a cargo mishap at the Ratchet docks, he ran off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. Bigglefuzz says he chased Magglish as far as Wailing Caverns, then stopped short of entering. Magglish uses stealth and smoke bombs when threatened, making him an elusive quarry.
Lord Cobrahn is a Fanglord who warns challengers that they will never wake the dreamer, placing him against those who seek to rouse the dreamer.
Lord Pythas is a Fanglord who threatens challengers with the coils of death and fights with Lightning Bolt.
Lady Anacondra is a Fanglord who declares that none can stand against the Serpent Lords. She uses Lightning Bolt.
Boahn bears the title Druid of the Fang. In combat, he can cast lightning and healing spells, change into snake form, and flee for help when badly injured.
Lord Serpentis is a Fanglord who calls himself the serpent king and boasts that he can do anything, in a rhyming line. He uses Lightning Bolt.
Skum is a named beast encountered in the Wailing Caverns; it uses Chained Bolt.

The Disciple of Naralex is responsible for preparing and performing the ritual to awaken Naralex from a nightmare in the Emerald Dream. The disciple explains that Naralex came hoping to regrow the Barrens, but serpentine visions tainted his thoughts and reptilian creatures now emerge from his dreams. They ask adventurers to protect them while they prepare and perform the ritual.

Naralex is a leader whose attempt to restore the Barrens through the Emerald Dream became a nightmare. If his disciple breaks through and wakes him, he thanks the disciple and companions and plans to gather with the other disciples before trying to restore the Barrens again.
A Druid of the Fang is an elite humanoid caster that uses Lightning Bolt and Druid's Slumber in combat.
Deviate Adders are animal combatants. When summoned, they join combat.
Deviate Crocolisks are animal combatants that use Tendon Rip.
Deviate Lashers are elemental combatants that use Wide Slash.
A Deviate Dreadfang is a beast of the Wailing Caverns. Ebru's effort to clear the caverns includes Dreadfangs, and this one uses Terrify in combat.
A Deviate Venomwing is a beast of the Wailing Caverns. In a fight, it attacks with Toxic Spit.
A Deviate Shambler is one of the creatures Ebru wants cleared from the Wailing Caverns. In combat, it can use Wild Regeneration.
Nalpak is a Disciple of Naralex who believes the deviate creatures’ hides can serve leatherworking, despite the creatures’ evil nature. He seeks those hides from the creatures infesting the caverns.

Ebru is a Disciple of Naralex focused on eradicating the corrupt deviate creatures haunting the caverns. She distinguishes this work from the effort by other disciples to awaken Naralex, whose failed dream brought the corruption.
Verdan the Everliving is a singular named creature in the Wailing Caverns, distinguished by grasping vines in combat.
Kalldan Felmoon is a specialist leatherworking-supplies vendor who offers goods to visitors.
Waldor teaches leatherworking and warns that the caverns below hold strange hides, reminding visitors that their own skin is far more valuable.
A faerie dragon that appears only briefly.
Deviate pythons are serpent creatures found in the world of Azeroth.
A hatchling of the Deviate Coiler kind, this juvenile is identified as a beast.

place_records.text: You are in the Wailing Caverns, a cavern system in the Barrens. Druids of the Fang, once an order of noble druids, now hold its tunnels under Lord Cobrahn, Lord Pythas and Mutanus the Devourer. They seek to remake the Barrens to match their own twisted dreams. Deviate creatures, including lashers and shamblers, still haunt the caverns.
